senses.gloss:
रि {vI.v} {c6c} P. (रियति, रीण) To go,
move. {vII.v} {c5c} P. (रिणोति) To hurt.
{vIII.v} {c9c} U. (रिणाति)
1 To drive out,
expel.
--2 Ved. To separate.
--3 To
emit.
--4 To give, grant.
--5 To go,
move.
--6 To hurt.

री {vI.v} {c4c} A. (रीयते) To trickle,
drip, distil, ooze, flow. {vII.v}
{c9c} U. (रिणाति, रिणीते, रीण; caus.
रेपयति-ते)
1 To go, move.
--2 To hurt,
injure, kill.
--3 To howl.
